summary: Spring Boot 3.4.5 URL shortener: create/redirect/metadata/delete with tombstones, destination policy, per-IP rate limit, file-based H2 + Flyway, health check

files.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>3.4.5</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>

    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>url-shortener</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <name>url-shortener</name>
    <description>URL shortener service: short links, redirects, expiry, token-authorized deletion</description>

    <properties>
        <java.version>17</java.version>
        <bucket4j.version>8.14.0</bucket4j.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-web</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-validation</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.flywaydb</groupId>
            <artifactId>flyway-core</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.h2database</groupId>
            <artifactId>h2</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.bucket4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>bucket4j_jdk17-core</artifactId>
            <version>${bucket4j.version}</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

spring:
  application:
    name: url-shortener
  datasource:
    # File-based H2 so links and tombstones survive restarts (NFR4). No external infrastructure.
    url: jdbc:h2:file:${shortener.data-dir}/shortener;DB_CLOSE_ON_EXIT=FALSE
    username: sa
  jpa:
    open-in-view: false
    hibernate:
      ddl-auto: validate   # Flyway owns the schema; Hibernate only checks it matches the entities
  flyway:
    enabled: true

server:
  port: 8080

shortener:
  data-dir: ./data
  rate-limit:
    creates-per-minute: 20
  code-length: 8

-- Links and tombstones. A deleted link keeps its row (code reserved forever) with the
-- destination URL and token hash erased, so codes and aliases are never reused (FR5).
CREATE TABLE links (
    id            BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    code          VARCHAR(32)              NOT NULL,
    original_url  VARCHAR(2048),
    custom_alias  BOOLEAN                  NOT NULL,
    created_at    TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL,
    expires_at    TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE,
    token_hash    VARCHAR(64),
    deleted_at    TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE,
    CONSTRAINT uk_links_code UNIQUE (code),
    CONSTRAINT ck_links_tombstone CHECK (
        (deleted_at IS NULL AND original_url IS NOT NULL AND token_hash IS NOT NULL)
        OR (deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND original_url IS NULL AND token_hash IS NULL)
    )
);

decisions.choice: File-based H2 under shortener.data-dir (./data) with Flyway V1 migration; Hibernate ddl-auto=validate
decisions.rationale: NFR4 and the human decision require durable local storage; Flyway owns the schema so Hibernate only verifies it

decisions.choice: Soft delete into a tombstone row that keeps the code and erases original_url and token_hash, enforced by a CHECK constraint
decisions.rationale: Codes and aliases are never reused (human decision); the constraint makes a half-deleted row impossible

decisions.choice: 256-bit SecureRandom token, unpadded base64url, stored as SHA-256 hex, compared with MessageDigest.isEqual
decisions.rationale: Human decision to store only a hash; constant-time comparison avoids a timing side channel

decisions.choice: Scheme, length and host checks, then resolve all addresses once at creation via an injectable HostResolver and fail closed on any prohibited address or resolution failure; fc00
decisions.rationale: /7 checked explicitly::Java's isSiteLocalAddress covers only the deprecated fec0::/10; the resolver seam lets tests avoid real DNS

decisions.choice: Bucket4j (com.bucket4j:bucket4j_jdk17-core 8.14.0, on the allowlist) per network peer address, 20 per minute refilled intervally, every create attempt counts, forwarding headers not trusted
decisions.rationale: Matches NFR3; counting invalid attempts also throttles probing; one bucket per distinct IP, acceptable for a single node

decisions.choice: api, health, links, error, actuator, matched case-insensitively
decisions.rationale: Prevents aliases shadowing service routes, including case variants

decisions.choice: Clock, SecureRandom and HostResolver are beans; shortener.data-dir and shortener.rate-limit.creates-per-minute are configurable
decisions.rationale: Tests can pin time, stub DNS, use an isolated database and lower the limit without waiting a minute

decisions.choice: Instants truncated to microseconds before storing
decisions.rationale: H2 TIMESTAMP(6) stores microseconds; truncating keeps creation and metadata responses identical
